summary: Floating-point parse dispatcher with an FPE guard. When the C-runtime FPE exception flag dword_5E9AD0 is non-zero, it writes error code 33 through the TLS slot returned by TLSOffsetGetter, resets the FPU control word via ReturnFPUControlWord(a3, 0xFFFF), and returns the input double a2 unchanged. When the flag is clear it delegates to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling(1, a1, low dword of a2, high dword of a2, 0, 0, a2, a3) and returns the resulting double.

local_names.a2: input double value, echoed on the error path and forwarded on the parse path
local_names.a3: FPU control word target forwarded to ReturnFPUControlWord and FloatParsingWithErrorHandling
local_names.result: double result of FloatParsingWithErrorHandling on the parse path

operations.description: If dword_5E9AD0 (C-runtime FPE exception flag) is non-zero, take the short-circuit error path.
Write error code 33 through the TLS slot returned by TLSOffsetGetter.
Reset the FPU control word with ReturnFPUControlWord(a3, 0xFFFF).
Error path: return the input double a2 unchanged.
Parse path: delegate to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling with the flag 1, the string a1, the low and high dwords of a2, two zeroed dwords, the original double a2 and a3.
Return the double produced by FloatParsingWithErrorHandling.
Invoked by sub_5895A2 as the gated floating-point parse entry.
